items.title: Women given free cycling shorts to prevent upskirting on Oktoberfest amusement ride

sentences.en: Women given free cycling shorts to prevent upskirting on Oktoberfest amusement ride.
sentences.zh: 女性获得了免费的自行车短裤，以防止在慕尼黑啤酒节游乐设施中出现裙边问题。

sentences.en: Investigation revealed thousands of voyeuristic videos taken on Munich beer festival’s Teufelsrad, or Devil’s Wheel Women have been given free cycling shorts to prevent upskirting on a famous amusement ride at the Oktoberfest in Munich, after an investigation revealed tens of thousands of voyeuristic videos circulating online.
sentences.zh: 调查显示，在慕尼黑啤酒节的Teufelsrad或Devil's Wheel Women上拍摄的成千上万的偷窥视频被免费提供自行车短裤，以防止在慕尼黑啤酒节的着名娱乐活动中出现骚动，此前一项调查显示有成千上万的偷窥视频在网上流传。

sentences.en: The Teufelsrad , or Devil’s Wheel, which rapidly spins around while people try to sit on it for as long as they can, is one of the beer festival’s oldest rides.
sentences.zh: Teufelsrad或魔鬼之轮（ Devil's Wheel ）是啤酒节最古老的游乐设施之一，当人们试图尽可能长时间地坐在它上面时，它会快速旋转。

sentences.en: But many of the videos discovered by German journalists focus on women whose traditional dirndl dresses have ridden up, often showing their underwear.
sentences.zh: 但德国记者发现的许多视频都集中在女性身上，她们穿着传统的迪伦德尔连衣裙，经常展示自己的内衣。

items.title: Greece returns priceless relics – and suggests UK should follow suit with Parthenon marbles

sentences.zh: 希腊总理希望将沙皇塞缪尔移交给保加利亚将使英国相信“真理，理性，正义和道德”的时机已经到来。希腊和保加利亚已经正式交换了遗物和骨头的“宝库” ，密封了几十年来谈判达成的文化协议。

sentences.en: The handover involved priceless religious objects removed from Greece at the height of the first world war, as well as remains thought to belong to Tsar Samuel, Bulgaria’s revered medieval warrior ruler.
sentences.zh: 移交涉及在第一次世界大战高峰期从希腊移走的无价宗教物品，以及被认为属于保加利亚受人尊敬的中世纪战士统治者沙皇塞缪尔的遗物。

sentences.zh: 由于军阀的儿子与无人机袭击燃料设施有关，利比亚团结谈判被颠覆。

sentences.en: Western Libya’s GNU say working with Saddam Haftar ‘impossible’ as US-backed merger plan breaks down Allegations that the son of the Libyan warlord Khalifa Haftar oversaw a “terror cell” that launched drone attacks on fuel storage facilities and power stations in western Libya have upended plans for the Tripoli-based government of national unity (GNU) to continue cooperating with Haftar on a plan to unify the country.
sentences.zh: 利比亚西部民族团结政府表示，与萨达姆·哈夫塔尔（ Saddam Haftar ）的合作“不可能” ，因为美国支持的合并计划打破了有关利比亚军阀哈利法·哈夫塔尔（ Khalifa Haftar ）的儿子监督一个“恐怖组织”对利比亚西部的燃料储存设施和发电站发动无人机袭击的指控，这颠覆了总部位于的黎波里的民族团结政府（ GNU ）继续与哈夫塔尔合作的计划，以实现该国的统一。

sentences.en: Saddam Haftar, the deputy commander of the so-called Libyan National Army (LNA), has increasingly been seen by the US as an important figure in its plans to unify Libyan security, judicial and political institutions.
sentences.zh: 所谓的利比亚国民军（ LNA ）副指挥官萨达姆·哈夫塔尔（ Saddam Haftar ）越来越多地被美国视为其统一利比亚安全、司法和政治机构的计划中的重要人物。

sentences.en: Sunday’s poll pits the leftist incumbent Lula against the son of a former far-right president convicted of staging a coup ‘No one disrespects Our Lady’: fears for Brazil’s patron saint grip country ahead of election Shortly after his controversial speech to the United Nations general assembly in September, Donald Trump gathered a dozen like-minded Latin American leaders and boasted that rightwing candidates had won all seven presidential elections held in the region since he began his second term.

sentences.en: Company says it is reviewing 50 petabytes of data after its agents accessed websites including Medicare without authorisation Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast OpenAI says its review in response to the Medicare and Hugging Face agent attacks is costing the company more than US$500,000 per day, as it deploys AI to examine data that would take a human 66m years to read.

items.title: Bangkok at breaking point as floods turn streets into stagnant lakes

sentences.en: Bangkok at breaking point as floods turn streets into stagnant lakes.
sentences.zh: 随着洪水将街道变成停滞不前的湖泊，曼谷正处于临界点。

sentences.en: With 40 dead and a disaster declared across all 50 city districts, experts warn extreme flooding will only worsen across south-east Asia Bangkok is used to absorbing the sudden afternoon downpours that inundate the city during the rainy season.
sentences.zh: 专家警告说，所有50个城市区都有40人死亡，并宣布发生灾难，极端洪水只会在东南亚地区恶化。曼谷被用来吸收雨季期间淹没该市的突如其来的下午倾盆大雨。

sentences.en: Even streets in many central high-rise districts can briefly turn into rivers, with rats and cockroaches racing out of sewers and taking temporary refuge on trees and buildings as the subterranean world is flushed out.
sentences.zh: 即使是许多中央高层区的街道也可能短暂变成河流，随着地下世界的冲刷，老鼠和蟑螂也会从下水道中跑出来，并在树木和建筑物上临时避难。

sentences.en: But every city has a breaking point, and this year rain fell so fast and so hard that whole neighbourhoods of the Thai capital have been transformed, not into rivers, but stagnant lakes.
sentences.zh: 但每个城市都有一个临界点，今年的降雨如此之快，如此之大，以至于泰国首都的整个街区都被改造成了停滞不前的湖泊，而不是河流。

sentences.zh: 巴西总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（ Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ）声称，他是唯一阻碍极右翼“法西斯主义者”夺回权力的人，因为他在周日的紧缩选举之前领导了一场在里约街头举行的大规模集会。

sentences.en: Speaking on the eve of the demonstration, the 80-year-old leftwinger said he had decided to seek a historic fourth term because he believed only he could prevent the family of his rightwing rival, Flávio Bolsonaro, returning to government.
sentences.zh: 在示威前夕，这位80岁的左翼分子表示，他决定寻求历史性的第四个任期，因为他相信只有他才能阻止他的右翼竞争对手弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（ Flávio Bolsonaro ）的家人重返政府。

sentences.en: Continue reading..
sentences.zh: 继续阅读

items.title: Hawaii's iconic 550-year-old Hōlei Sea Arch collapses

sentences.en: Hawaii's iconic 550-year-old Hōlei Sea Arch collapses.
sentences.zh: 夏威夷标志性的550年历史的Hōlei海拱门倒塌。

sentences.en: The lava rock formation protruding from the rocky cliffs of Volcanoes National Park crumbled some time last weekend.
sentences.zh: 上周末，从火山国家公园的岩石悬崖上突出的熔岩岩层崩塌了一段时间。

items.title: Streamline: custom video pipelines with Cloudflare Stream and Workers

sentences.en: Streamline: custom video pipelines with Cloudflare Stream and Workers.
sentences.zh: 简化：使用Cloudflare Stream和工作人员的自定义视频管道。

sentences.en: Cloudflare Stream is a powerful broadcasting platform that, for many of our customers, just works.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare Stream是一个功能强大的广播平台，对于我们的许多客户来说，它只是工作。

sentences.en: But what if you wanted to render dynamic annotations on a livestream or create an alternate version of a hosted video with burned-in subtitles?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果您想在直播中渲染动态注释，或者创建带有刻录字幕的托管视频的替代版本，该怎么办？

sentences.en: You would need to run a custom video pipeline.
sentences.zh: 您需要运行自定义视频管道。

sentences.en: Today, we’re releasing a new developer playground, Streamline, that demonstrates how you can build a system to deliver these bespoke video experiences on Cloudflare’s Developer Platform.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们发布了一个新的开发者游乐场Streamline ，展示了如何构建一个系统，在Cloudflare的开发者平台上提供这些定制的视频体验。

sentences.en: We’ll walk you through how Streamline leverages Workers, Containers, and several media protocols to modify video — and immediately publish that output as livestream or new hosted video.
sentences.zh: 我们将向您介绍Streamline如何利用Workers、Containers和多种媒体协议来修改视频，并立即将输出内容发布为直播或新托管视频。

sentences.en: You’ll also have the opportunity to try it for your projects.
sentences.zh: 您还有机会在您的项目中试用。

sentences.en: A processing pipeline needs a durable, long-running environment that can run specialized, compiled code with predictable memory and CPU capacity.
sentences.zh: 处理管道需要一个持久、长时间运行的环境，该环境可以运行具有可预测内存和CPU容量的专用编译代码。

sentences.en: Video streams can run for minutes or hours, so the media process needs a lifecycle independent of the request that started it.
sentences.zh: 视频流可以运行几分钟或几小时，因此媒体流程需要一个独立于启动请求的生命周期。

sentences.en: An application should be able to start a pipeline, send its input, inspect it, and stop it without needing to keep a single request open for the entire duration.
sentences.zh: 应用程序应该能够启动管道，发送其输入，检查它并停止它，而无需在整个持续时间内保持单个请求打开。

sentences.en: Cloudflare provides the primitives we need.
sentences.zh: Cloudflare提供了我们需要的原语。

sentences.en: Containers are long-lived runtimes suitable for media processing.
sentences.zh: 容器是适用于媒体处理的长寿命运行时间。
